summary: Quantum Cyber N.V. filed an 8-K reporting two items: (1) a material amendment to an equity distribution agreement with Maxim Group LLC, increasing the at-the-market offering capacity from $10M to $100M of ordinary shares, and (2) a consulting agreement with CFO William Caragol for $20,000/month through August 2026 with possible extension. Neither item constitutes a special situation; the ATM amendment is a routine financing facility, and the CFO consulting agreement is compensatory. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is present. The advisor or recommendation details are not applicable.
